# Deprecated / Dropped GPU Architecture Support — Extraction from CUDA 13.4 Update 1 Release Notes

## Summary of Findings

This document contains **limited** architecture deprecation information. The platform-level deprecation section (§2.6.2) mentions only **one future ARM architecture change**; the Maxwell/Pascal/Volta removal appears **only in library-specific release notes** (cuFFT, cuSPARSE), not in the platform section. There is **no information** about CUDA 12.x architecture drops, and **no statement** of when `sm_90` was first introduced. Gaps are detailed at the end.
